Priyom —

Quick economics: attached workbook has two scenarios (base / upside). If we cap uplift at 3%/yr and provide a mechanism to cap overage pricing via an agreed uplift band, our modeled ARR is down ~9% NPV over 3 years vs standard cadence. However, the customer brings strategic value in the Midwest health vertical and pipeline expansion probability is high.

Recommended binding controls for approval without exec sign-off:
- Annual usage band gates: if usage > 1.5x forecast in a year, incremental usage priced at a 10% uplift above base (so we don't give away the tail).
- Quarterly review and true-up clause tied to their monthly reports.
- Data residency and audit clause: Orion agrees to share anonymized monthly usage reports to enable audits.

If Marketing/Strategy wants the reference, we can accept tighter uplift margins but would need a one-time onboarding fee and a partial prepayment (30% of year 1). If you want aggressive concessions beyond this, will need VP approval.

Ben

Team —

Thanks Ben — that analysis helps. Given the NPV hit and the non-standard renewal protection language, this needs an exec exception. I'm drafting an approval request for Marissa and Laura to sign off (execs want: rationale, quantified revenue delta, and mitigations).

Proposed conditional approval that I will recommend to the Execs:
1) Price anchor: 3-year term with a unit-rate uplift not to exceed 3%/yr.
2) Uplift cap: usage over 1.5x forecast priced at base * 1.10 (10% premium) for any incremental usage within that year.
3) Renewal protection: Redwood will not increase unit rates in the first 30 days after a renewal effective date; longer-term increases allowed with 90-day notice thereafter.
4) Commercial mitigations: 30% prepayment of Y1 revenue OR a one-time onboarding fee of $75k (customer choice).
5) Audit & reports: Orion to provide monthly usage reports and a quarterly reconciliation clause.

If Marissa and Laura are comfortable with those guardrails, I'll submit to Finance + Legal for final wording and circulate to the Execs for sign-off.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni

All — approved with conditions below. Thanks Vivek for the crisp mitigations and Ben for the financials. Please capture these bullets in the SOW and commercial addendum, legal to insert precise definitions:

1) Term anchor: 36 months. Unit rates capped at +3% compound annually vs year 1 baseline.
2) Uplift on overflow: incremental usage above 1.5x annual forecast priced at base * 1.10 (10% premium) for that annual period.
3) Renewal safety net: no unilateral increases during the first 30 days post-renewal; thereafter Redwood may give 90 days notice for changes.
4) Customer choice: 30% prepaid Y1 or onboarding fee of $75,000 (document whichever option they select).
5) Audit & reporting: Orion to supply monthly anonymized usage reports and allow one annual audit of aggregated metrics.
6) Executive re-evaluation trigger: if actual revenue falls >15% below model after year 2, the exception will be rescinded and standard pricing restored for new consumption.

Conditions legal asked to include: precise definitions of "usage", mechanism for computing incremental pricing, and a cap on aggregate discounts across the term. Once legal inserts redlines, Priyom please get customer's signoff on the option selection and route the PO.

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
